response.sql:
WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    mix_count,
    mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    mix_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_type_mix,
  mix_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY order_type_mix;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row is counted once, using its translink to include the associated transaction; the missing-value group label '[missing]' is distinct from any stored order type with that exact text.
